properties.name: A verification whose conditions rest on claims that lose their support reads stale, naming which conditions no longer hold, and a what-if lists it
properties.statement:
When a Verification is constrained or parameterised by claims (a threat-emulator setting concluded from an assessment), and those claims become unsupported, refuted or merely conditional, the Verification reads `stale`: get_node, reasoning_report and propagate_from name it, with each failing condition. It is never silently `planned` or `passing`.
MEASURED 2026-10-19 in the FICTIONAL capstone (2a26dc6044306d27): after U1, two of the test's five emulator constraints had no holding derivation, yet ver:kestrel-threat-emulator-test stayed `planned` with no marker. The R3 what-if counted the test but did not name it.
